run_add_headers_cli: run the script to scan a directory and add Meta copyright headers to all Python files
check_and_add_header_single_file: check if a single Python file has the Meta header and add it if missing
scan_directory_for_headers: scan a directory recursively for Python files and add Meta copyright headers where needed
refactor_check_and_add_header: refactor check_and_add_header to support custom header templates instead of hardcoded Meta header
review_scan_directory: review the scan_directory function to understand how it walks directories and filters Python files
